TC-19/S12.detail: B04 on dev 8b4be94a, live model: STILL for the one-time dose, Hospital only. Magnesium re-dated 3/10 charts (Hospital 3/5: H2, H4, H5; Nursing Home 0/5): the live parse returned 'Magnesium sulfate 2 g IV once' with status 'single-dose' (the row's own status) although the dictation never named it, and the merge stamped it: changeDate 'Oct 19' -> 'Oct 20', updatedAt = the save time (+~9 s), panel tag 'Given · Oct 19' -> 'Given · Oct 20' (screenshot H2). In H1 / H3 the model echoed magnesium as 'active' and the merge dropped it ('Given · Oct 19 · not mentioned today' kept). The Nursing Home parse returned no medication list at all in 5/5, so nothing could be re-dated there. Because the dose's updatedAt is the save time, its 36 h clock restarts at the echo (the same code path the local probe aged: still on the chart at +18 h, leaves 36 h after the echo). Held lisinopril / stopped vancomycin / active metoprolol: kept 10/10 (status, changeDate, changedNote, updatedAt unchanged); in all 5 Hospital charts the model echoed all four drugs (held and stopped ones as 'active') and the merge dropped them. Controls 3/3: no medication row moved. Code: apps/web/convex/lib/medications.ts:363-456 mergePreRoundMedications (371-372 singleDoseRow match, 437/447/455 re-stamp; the 'not dictated, no news' guard at 402-409 covers only status 'active').
